description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム SEED FREEDOM』でも複数機で活躍！専用パーツの差替えによりMA形態への変形も再現したオーブの量産型可変MSが商品化！
description.en: Also active in multiple aircraft in "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM"! Orb's mass-produced variable MS that reproduces the transformation to MA form by replacing special parts has been commercialized!

description.ja: • 戦闘機状態のシルエットを美しく表現するため、変形機構をオミットしパーツ差替えでMA形態のフォルムを再現。
description.en: • In order to beautifully express the silhouette of the fighter plane, the deformation mechanism has been removed and the MA form has been reproduced by replacing parts.

description.ja: • ビームライフルのフォアグリップは収納・展開が可能。MA形態時にはライフルを主翼に接続することができる。
description.en: • The beam rifle's foregrip can be stored and expanded. When in MA mode, the rifle can be connected to the main wing.

description.ja: • 全身の差し色をはじめ、頭部の色分けなどはパーツ分割で細部まで再現。
description.en: • The coloring of the whole body and the color-coding of the head are reproduced in detail by dividing the parts.

description.ja: • 複数機を揃えることで、編隊を組んだ作戦行動を再現することも可能。
description.en: • By arranging multiple aircraft, it is also possible to reproduce operations in formation.
